subject: general
question: Preeti can do a work in 36 days. Anu can do the same work in 30 days. If Preeti and Anu start the work together but Anu leaves the work 3 days before its completion, find the number of days in which the total work is completed.
solution:
Given:

Preeti can do the work in 36 days.

Anu can do the same work in 30 days

Concept used:

Total days of work = Work/(One day work)

Calculation:

Total work = LCM of 36 and 30 = 180 units

Efficiency of Preeti = 180/36 = 5

Efficiency of Anu = 180/30 = 6

Let the time taken be x days.

⇒ 5x + 6(x - 3) = 180

⇒ 11x = 198

⇒ x = 18

**The answer is 18 days.**
